title: FINNALA corner section
description: FINNALA corner section, Grann/Bomstad black The contact surfaces are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have BOMSTAD, a coated fabric that has a similar look and feel to leather.
features: The seat cushion and back cushions are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
materialAndCare: Smolder resistant lining/ Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Frame: Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft., Plywood, Particleboard, Solid wood, Fiberboard; Leg: Polypropylene; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft.; Back cushion: 30% cut polyurethane foam/ 70% polyester fibers; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface
